items.phonetic: dɪd tɑm gɪt ə ʧæns tɪ du ðət?

items.sentence_en: When did Tom see that happening?
items.sentence_vi: Tom thấy điều đó xảy ra khi nào?
items.phonetic: wɪn dɪd tɑm si ðət ˈhæpənɪŋ?

items.sentence_en: Tom wants to go to Mary's party.
items.sentence_vi: Tom muốn đến bữa tiệc của Mary.
items.phonetic: tɑm wɔnts tɪ goʊ tɪ ˈmɛriz ˈpɑrti.

items.sentence_en: You should've been home by 2:30.
items.sentence_vi: Bạn nên về nhà lúc 2:30.
items.phonetic: ju ˈʃʊdəv bɪn hoʊm baɪ 2:30*

items.sentence_en: I didn't want to fight with Tom.
items.sentence_vi: Tôi không muốn đánh nhau với Tom.

items.sentence_en: I didn't know what Tom could do.

items.sentence_en: We joined Tom the following day.
